leads.title: Shaul Ganon / Aguda (Israeli-based gay rights group) - statement quoted in article
leads.documents: Arrest and torture of gay Palestinians by Palestinian Authority; PA practice of labeling gays as collaborators; two cases in last three years tried explicitly for being homosexuals; claim it became impossible to be an open gay in the PA since the intifada when police increasingly began enforcing Islamic law; claim gay Palestinians are blackmailed into working as informants by Israeli security services
